description: Read one of your tasks (platform.task@1: state, result, cost, explanation) with GET /api/v1/tasks/:id, and watch it live with GET /api/v1/tasks/:id/events: text/event-stream of actor.task-event@1 (state changes, the agent's steps, the end), resumable with Last-Event-ID. Only the task's requester (or its project's tokens) can read it.
